message: 発展途上な痴話喧嘩

name: Synn
message: 「We were told to come here, but there's nobody around」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Who might our coach be?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hmm. Nobody's here」

name: Sally
message: 「Heeey」

name: Misa
message: 「I wonder what sort of person is knowledgeable about this kind of thing」

name: Ria
message: 「Maybe someone into ancient martial arts or something like that」

name: Paqy
message: 「Preconceptions are a scary thing, man」

name: Sally
message: 「Ahem. Everybody pay attention to meee!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, what's up, Sally-chan?」

name: Misa
message: 「You mustn't skip out on your part-time job」

name: Sally
message: 「Grrr! I'm the coach!」

name: Everyone
message: 「Whaaaaaaat!」

name: Sally
message: 「Er-hem. Allow me to re-intro-duce myself! I'm Sally-chan, and today I'll be in charge of the stu-dent council's special training」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're the teacher... I'm worried」

name: Sally
message: 「What was thaaat」

name: Lolotte
message: 「This is a major crisis! The Chairwoman has joined forces with a Demon!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is it really that big of a deal...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「By doing so, she's trying to make us lose, you know!?」

name: Ria
message: 「T-That's not true\s01」

name: Paqy
message: 「You guys might've forgotten, but Flat-chest is stronger than any of the Crusaders here」

name: Paqy
message: 「At least for now, anyway」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that so...」

name: Misa
message: 「Indeed... In a one-on-one fight, we might not be able to beat her」

name: Sally
message: 「Ahem!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, but in these kinds of sentai shows, isn't it standard for the early monsters to get weaker once they join the good guys?」

name: Synn
message: 「I used to watch those at your place all the time when we were kids, Nanaka.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You two were already living together when you were that young?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-N-No we weren't!」

name: Sally
message: 「Somehow that makes me super mad! I'm the teacher here! I won't go easy on you anymore!」

name: Sally
message: 「Besides, the Chairwoman told me to drill you guys hard. So you'd better be ready!」

name: Misa
message: 「So, Sally-san. What sort of special training will you be putting us through?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Special training, huh...」

name: Sally
message: 「Hehehe, I'm glad you asked. Why, I, Sally-chan, will--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hold on a second!」

name: Sally
message: 「Aww~ I was just getting to the good part.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Sally-chan, do you actually know how strong everyone is?」

name: Sally
message: 「Don't underestimate me!」

name: Misa
message: 「We have fought before, after all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, but a lot has happened since then, and I think we've gotten stronger too.」

name: Synn
message: 「True.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Right, right? So I think it'd be better if you saw what we're capable of right now.」

name: Ria
message: 「That makes sense.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What's gotten into you, Treasurer!? You're going to give yourself a fever from thinking so hard.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「How about we have a mock battle in front of Sally-chan? If we split into 2:2:1 with rock-paper-scissors, that'll be perfect.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You still haven't fixed that habit of yours during rock-paper-scissors, huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You always throw the exact same thing first.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that how it was?! Come to think of it, I feel like I always lose to Nanaka at rock-paper-scissors」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-It's not like I threw the same thing because I wanted to team up with you, okay? It was just a coincidence」

name: Synn
message: 「You don't have to go out of your way to say that...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Pathetic」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shut u--」

name: Paqy
message: 「Whoa, hold on. Right now it's strategy time for fighting Hisu and Ria-chan」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you have some kind of plan?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Plan?」

name: Synn
message: 「Personally, I think at the very least we should split roles into offense and defense」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, both Nanaka and I are offense types, right? In that case, maybe we just brute-force it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Get a grip, Nanaka」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa is definitely going to try to stall us, so how do we close the distance... Should I act as a decoy?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We finally get to be alone together, so...」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Eh, ah, yeah, sorry. What is it?」

name: Synn
message: 「I know you're thinking really hard, but there are two of us, so let's think it through together」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-Yeah, you're right. Ahahaha」

name: Synn
message: 「Did you come up with anything?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ooooh! Ria-chan's transformation scene is starting!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, hold on! We're still in the middle of a strategy meeting!」
I almost end up looking where he ran off to, but--

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh, no, no, snap out of it!」
I hurriedly looked away and faced Nanaka.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Grr, I can't lose to Ria-senpai... Even I--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「M-Maybe I should transform too...」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat!?」
I-Is this Ria-senpai at the front gate and Nanaka at the back!?

name: Synn
message: 「You don't have to go out of your way to transform right in front of me...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I already know that! B-But, still...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We're childhood friends, aren't we!! Being naked is no big deal!」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Maybe so, but... it's still embarrassing...\s03」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's so embarrassing even I want to run away. Still, if I don't do at least this much...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If I don't go this far, Synn won't...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Here I go, Synn!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't go!!」
I ended up staring right at her.
Compared to when we were kids, her feminine curves were incomparably more defined.
No matter how long we've been childhood friends, this isn't something you just get used to.
On the contrary, I end up remembering how she looks like this even during normal times, so my heart is always racing.

name: Nanaka
message: 「H-How was it?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「--Wait, I'm such an idiot!! Why am I asking something so weird!」
Still, Nanaka is holding back her embarrassment and doing her best too.
I-I have to--

name: Synn
message: 「I'm going to transform too. Nanaka... watch closely, okay!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey!! Synn!?」

name: Synn
message: 「If we get embarrassed over transforming, the enemy will wipe us out!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-No, stop!! That's not--that's not what I meant at all~~」

name: Misa
message: 「Those two... just what are they doing?」

name: Sally
message: 「A married comedy duo?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Both of your faces are bright red」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahaha...\s02」

name: Paqy
message: 「All that hard work on the soba went right down the drain」

name: Synn
message: 「Trans-form!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gaaah, stop it!!」

name: Helena
message: 「You mustn't be afraid to get naked. Sometimes taking off your armor actually makes you stronger!」

name: Synn
message: 「I see! Now that I think about it, even in a game I own, there was a character whose Armor Class number was lower when naked!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Exactly! For noticing such a good point, I'll present you with this trophy!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I am NOT a 'kunoichi'!!」
